episodeTitle.en: Become a better communicator: Specific frameworks to improve your clarity, influence, and impact
episodeTitle.zh: 成为更出色的沟通者：提升清晰度、影响力和成果的具体框架

guestBioOfficial.en: Wes Kao is an entrepreneur, coach, and advisor. She co-founded the live learning platform Maven, backed by First Round and a16z. Before Maven, Wes co-created the altMBA with best-selling author Seth Godin. Today, Wes teaches a popular course on executive communication and influence. Through her course and one-on-one coaching, she’s helped thousands of operators, founders, and product leaders master the art of influence through clear, compelling communication. Known for her surgical writing style and no-BS frameworks, Wes returns to the pod to deliver a tactical master class on becoming a sharper, more persuasive communicator—at work, in meetings, and across your career. What you’ll learn:
guestBioOfficial.zh: 韦斯·考（Wes Kao）是一位企业家、教练和顾问。她与First Round和a16z合作创立了实时学习平台Maven。在创立Maven之前，韦斯与畅销书作家赛斯·高丁（Seth Godin）共同创建了altMBA项目。如今，韦斯教授一门关于高管沟通与影响力的热门课程。通过她的课程和一对一辅导，她帮助数千名运营者、创始人和产品负责人掌握通过清晰、有说服力的沟通来提升影响力的艺术。韦斯以其精准的写作风格和直击要害的框架而闻名，她重返播客，为听众带来一堂关于如何成为更敏锐、更有说服力的沟通者的战术大师课——无论是在职场、会议中，还是在整个职业生涯中。你将学到：

title.en: Become a better communicator: Specific frameworks to improve your clarity, influence, and impact
title.zh: 成为更出色的沟通者：提升清晰度、影响力和成果的具体框架

summary.en: Wes shares how to communicate as an executive and increase your influence, built around George Bernard Shaw's line that the single biggest problem in communication is the illusion that it has taken place. She covers being specific instead of vague, earning trust through clarity, and why strong communication compounds across a career. The episode is a practical guide to a high-leverage skill most people underinvest in.
summary.zh: Wes 分享了如何以高管的方式沟通、提升影响力，其核心是萧伯纳那句名言：沟通中最大的单一问题，就是“以为沟通已经发生”的错觉。她涵盖了用具体取代含糊、通过清晰赢得信任，以及为什么出色的沟通会在整个职业生涯中产生复利。本期是关于一项大多数人投入不足的高杠杆技能的务实指南。
